# Winter Clothing Canada

Seven pages for real Canadian cold: 50 products from Mountain Warehouse (25) and Columbia (25) — parkas and boots — with CAD prices checked live on the retailers' own sites on November 6, 2026, a live price tracker, a deals page with the biggest discounts, product filters and search, a comparison table, and compact detail sections with honest flaws.

- [Winter Clothing Canada](https://yorkdigitalagency.github.io/canada-winter-clothing/): Home — our 3 top picks and links to the four guides.
- [Best Deals on Winter Parkas & Boots](https://yorkdigitalagency.github.io/canada-winter-clothing/deals.html): Deals — every product on sale, with a photo, the saving shown as a bar, the lowest price seen, and whether the price moved since the last check.
- [Warmest Parkas for Extreme Cold](https://yorkdigitalagency.github.io/canada-winter-clothing/parkas-extreme-cold.html): 12 parkas — the warmest we list. Lab-tested °C where the brand publishes one; Columbia publishes no lab °C rating, so its insulation figures are shown instead.
- [Budget Parkas Under $200](https://yorkdigitalagency.github.io/canada-winter-clothing/parkas-budget.html): 12 parkas — the cheapest we list, all under $200 at the last check.
- [Everyday Parkas](https://yorkdigitalagency.github.io/canada-winter-clothing/parkas-everyday.html): 11 parkas — for city winter and short trips outside.
- [Winter Boots](https://yorkdigitalagency.github.io/canada-winter-clothing/boots.html): 16 boots — snow boots from both brands, split across two pages (page 1: boots 1–8, page 2: boots 9–16).
- [Winter Boots, page 2](https://yorkdigitalagency.github.io/canada-winter-clothing/boots-page-2.html): boots 9–16.

Price tracker (checked November 6, 2026; re-checked three times a day): 50 products tracked, 28 on sale right now. Biggest saving: Mountain Warehouse Antarctic Extreme, 63% off — $340 CAD off ($199.99 CAD, was $539.99 CAD). Every product shows the date its price was last checked and the lowest price we have seen; a re-check that finds a lower price adds a "Price dropped" badge. Prices range $49.99–$549.99 CAD. Prices change — the retailer's page is the final word.

This site sells nothing. Retailer links go to the retailers' own pages. No affiliate links are active yet; when added, they will be clearly marked. Product pictures are created images of similar products, not the actual product photos; 50 of 50 products have matched pictures so far. No hands-on testing: warmth and specs are the brands' own published figures.
